description: Call scripts with token placeholders. Use {COMPANY}, {CALLER_NAME}, {PROSPECT_NAME}, {PRODUCT}, etc.

problemQuestion.name: Problem Question (Recommended)
problemQuestion.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. I'll be honest — this is a cold call, so I'll be quick. Are you seeing pressure to [SPECIFIC PROBLEM] in your [AREA], or is that not really on your radar yet?"
problemQuestion.why: Opens with THEIR situation. Acknowledges the interruption. The question is easy to answer and gets them talking.

costQuestion.name: Cost Reduction Question
costQuestion.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. Quick question — is reducing [COST AREA] something that's on your priority list this year, or is that not where the pressure is right now?"
costQuestion.why: Goes straight to a pain point. If they say yes, you have an opening. If they say no, you can pivot.

performanceQuestion.name: Performance Gap Question
performanceQuestion.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. I'm curious — are you getting everything you need out of [THEIR SYSTEM] right now, or is there a gap between what it could do and what it's actually doing?"
performanceQuestion.why: Invites them to share frustrations. Most users feel they're not getting full value.

permissionHybrid.name: Permission + Problem Hybrid
permissionHybrid.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. I'll be honest — this is a cold call, so I'll be quick. A lot of companies we talk to are [COMMON SITUATION]. Is that something you'd want to explore, or is this a bad time?"
permissionHybrid.why: Acknowledges the cold call, hints at value, gives them an easy out (which paradoxically makes them more likely to engage).

primary.name: Primary Value Pivot
primary.script: "So here's why I called you specifically. {COMPANY} is [VALUE PROPOSITION]. But what's really relevant right now is [SPECIFIC BENEFIT]. {PROOF_POINT}. Is that the kind of thing that would be useful to explore?"
primary.when: After they show interest or acknowledge the problem

interestShown.name: Interest Shown Pivot
interestShown.script: "Perfect — that's exactly why I'm reaching out. [DESCRIBE SOLUTION]. Most companies haven't dug into it yet because, frankly, their existing partners haven't either. We're different — [DIFFERENTIATOR]. Would it be useful to see what's actually possible?"
interestShown.when: When they express interest in the topic

costPressure.name: Cost Pressure Pivot
costPressure.script: "That's exactly what we help with. {COMPANY} [COST VALUE PROP]. {PROOF_POINT}. Would it be worth exploring what's possible for your situation?"

meetingOffer.name: Meeting Offer Close
meetingOffer.script: "Here's what I'd suggest. I'd love to set up a [DURATION]-minute call with [MEETING_WITH] — no pitch, just a conversation. They'll walk you through [WHAT THEY'LL LEARN], and whether any of it makes sense for your plans. If it's not relevant, you'll know in [DURATION] minutes. Would [specific day] at [specific time] work?"
meetingOffer.when: When prospect is engaged and interested

collateralOffer.name: Collateral Offer Close
collateralOffer.script: "I get it — timing isn't always right for a call. Tell you what: we've put together a really practical [COLLATERAL DESCRIPTION] — not theory, actual use cases and results. Would it be useful if I sent that over? It's a good way to see if our approach resonates, and if it does, we can talk further when the timing makes sense."
collateralOffer.when: When prospect is interested but not ready for meeting

hybridClose.name: Hybrid Close
hybridClose.script: "Here's an idea: let me send you our [COLLATERAL] — it's practical, not salesy, and shows how companies are getting real results. Take a look, and if it resonates, I'll connect you with [MEETING_WITH] for a [DURATION]-minute conversation to go deeper. That way you can see our thinking first before committing any time. Fair?"
hybridClose.when: When you want to give them an easy on-ramp

existingPartner.response: "Makes sense — most companies do. Quick question: are they bringing you insights on [NEW CAPABILITY], or is that not really their focus? [If not] We've put together [COLLATERAL DESCRIPTION]. Might be a useful benchmark even if you stay with your current partner. Worth sending over?"

notLooking.trigger: We're not looking for new vendors
notLooking.response: "Completely fair — I'm not asking you to switch anything today. What I can offer is our [COLLATERAL] — it shows how companies are getting real results. Good for staying current even if you're not making changes. Can I send it over so you have it when the time is right?"

sendEmail.response: "Happy to. I'll include our [COLLATERAL] — it's the most useful thing I can share. It covers [KEY VALUE]. Take a look, and if it resonates, we can talk further. What email should I use?"

handleInHouse.response: "That's great — strong internal teams are valuable. We've put together [COLLATERAL] that might be useful for your team — practical frameworks and real results, not vendor marketing. Could save them some research time. Worth sending over?"

notReady.response: "Honestly, that's what most companies say — and it's fair. What's changed is [RECENT DEVELOPMENT]. We've put together [COLLATERAL] that shows what's actually possible now and how to implement it with real impact. Good for planning even if you're not ready to move yet. Can I send it over?"

whatMakesDifferent.response: "Three things. First, [DIFFERENTIATOR 1]. Second, [DIFFERENTIATOR 2]. Third, [DIFFERENTIATOR 3]. Want me to send [COLLATERAL] so you can see our thinking?"

callBackLater.response: "Totally fair. Let me send you our [COLLATERAL] in the meantime — it's practical and worth a look when you have 10 minutes. I'll follow up in a couple weeks to see if it sparked any questions. If the timing's better then, we can set up a proper conversation. Sound good?"

tooExpensive.response: "I understand budget is critical. Here's the thing — [COST VALUE PROP]. And [SOLUTION] typically shows ROI in [TIMEFRAME]. {PROOF_POINT}. Would it help to see a business case from a similar company?"

call.name: Follow-up Call Script
call.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, it's {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. I sent over our [COLLATERAL] last week — did you get a chance to look at it? [If yes] What stood out to you? [If no] No worries — I know things get busy. The key takeaway is [KEY BENEFIT]. Would it be worth a quick call with [MEETING_WITH] to explore whether any of that applies to your situation?"

email.subject: Quick question about the [COLLATERAL]
email.body:
Hi {PROSPECT_NAME},

I sent over our [COLLATERAL] last week. Curious if anything resonated — particularly the sections on [KEY TOPICS].

If it's useful, I'd love to connect you with [MEETING_WITH] for a [DURATION]-minute conversation to go deeper. If the timing's not right, no worries — just let me know and I'll check back in a few months.

— {CALLER_NAME}

openingsNonSF._description: Scripts for prospects NOT currently using your product

crmPain.name: CRM Pain Question (Recommended)
crmPain.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. I'll be quick — I'm calling because we help companies get better visibility into their [AREA]. Quick question: are you happy with how you're currently [DOING X], or is that an area where you're looking to improve?"
crmPain.why: Opens with business value, not product. Gets them talking about their current situation.

growthChallenge.name: Growth Challenge Question
growthChallenge.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. Quick question for you — as your business has grown, has [CHALLENGE] become harder, or do you have that pretty well sorted?"
growthChallenge.why: Connects to a universal growth pain point.

techStack.name: Tech Stack Curiosity
techStack.script: "Hi {PROSPECT_NAME}, this is {CALLER_NAME} from {COMPANY}. We're a [TYPE] partner, and I'm curious — what are you using to [DO X] today? Spreadsheets, another system, or something else?"
techStack.why: Direct and honest. Gets intel on their current setup immediately.

pivotsNonSF._description: Pivots for non-users of your product

fromSpreadsheets.name: From Spreadsheets
fromSpreadsheets.script: "I hear that a lot — spreadsheets work until they don't. The challenge is [COMMON PROBLEM]. That's exactly when companies look at [SOLUTION]. The good news is [VALUE PROP]. Would it be worth a quick conversation to see what's actually involved?"

fromCompetitor.name: From Competitor
fromCompetitor.script: "[COMPETITOR] is a good starting point, but a lot of companies outgrow it — especially around [LIMITATIONS]. [YOUR PRODUCT]'s [ADVANTAGE] is genuinely game-changing. We've helped several companies migrate, and the ROI is usually clear within months. Want to hear what that looks like?"

fromNothing.name: From No System
fromNothing.script: "Honestly, that's where a lot of growing companies are. You get by until suddenly you can't — [PAIN POINTS]. The smart move is getting on a proper platform before it becomes urgent. [PRODUCT] is the market leader for good reason, and with {COMPANY}'s approach, it's more affordable than most people think. Would it be useful to see what's actually involved?"
